### Borea v0.6.17

A patch release for the default mod loader. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- An instance whose mods need no mod loader now uses StarMap. Before, Borea chose the first loader in alphabetical order, so an empty instance offered Oxidizer. When several loaders are installed, StarMap starts such an instance, and the loader setting and the setup list StarMap first.

Full changelog: [v0.6.16...v0.6.17](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.16...v0.6.17)
